name: dsh-ptforge
description: Cisco Packet Tracer automation for DeepSeek Harness: build, inspect and configure .pkt topologies offline (Twofish-EAX container codec + PT XML model) and open them in Packet Tracer. Exposes 18 pt_* tools (build / patch / state / check / notes / web / report offline; exec / assert / ping / http / ftp on a live Windows Packet Tracer).
